SELECT s."School", s."AdmFName1", s."AdmFName2", s."AdmFName3",
       f."District Code", f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)",
       f."Free Meal Count (K-12)", f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM "schools" AS s
LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS f ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE 'Alusine' IN (s."AdmFName1", s."AdmFName2", s."AdmFName3");
